Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position. 
 
 Job Description:
 

 The Role  

 Fidelity’s Charitable Technology group is adding an Angular-focused Full Stack Developer in Durham. We're looking for a hardworking, collaborative, analytical thinker to help deliver the best digital solutions to our customers. The ideal candidate is entrenched in full stack development, with a passion for leveraging the right tools and frameworks to guide the development of stable, robust, and resilient apps that best serve our customer initiatives.

 Fidelity Charitable engineers develop next-generation technology that directly impacts how our customers accomplish their philanthropic goals. As a developer within our technology business unit, you will help take Fidelity Charitable applications to the next level of evolution. The position will require hands-on software development, cross team collaboration with a diverse and co-located engineering team, and the ability to visualize customer issues as drivers for internal change.

 Writing front-end and back-end code that fulfills various business needs across a variety of applications
 Work effectively with developers, stakeholders and cross-functional teams
 Commitment to producing clean, well-tested, and refactored code
 Dedication to continuous improvement, actively helping to elevate both personal and team performance
 Assisting with a wide variety of development, analysis, and testing responsibilities to ensure that the team can meet its software delivery commitments
 
 The Expertise and Skills You Bring 

 2+ years of full stack engineering and development experience
 Must have experience developing modern web applications using Angular and TypeScript
 Experience with HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, and responsive web development
 Experience with core Angular concepts, including components, services, routing, forms, and dependency injection
 Experience developing or integrating RESTful APIs
 Experience with a server-side development technology such as Java/Spring Boot
 Experience working with SQL and relational databases
 Experience with Git and source control
 Experience developing or deploying applications in AWS cloud environments
 Experience developing unit and integration tests
 Experience troubleshooting applications across front-end and back-end components
 Familiarity with CI/CD and automated build/deployment processes
 Understanding of web application security and secure coding practices
 Experience working in an Agile software development environment
 Experience developing mobile or cross-platform applications using Angular is a plus
 NgRx or advanced state management experience is helpful
 Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and cloud platforms is a plus
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent
 
 The Team 

 Fidelity Charitable is a 501(c)(3) public charity. We help donors maximize their generosity through our donor-advised fund, called the Giving Account. Established in 1991, we are the nation’s top grantmaker, distributing $18.3 billion to charities in 2025.

 Fidelity’s Charitable Technology group develops the next-generation technologies that directly impacts how customers accomplish their philanthropic goals. As a member of the Fidelity Philanthropic Services business unit, you will help Fidelity Charitable applications evolve through hands-on software development, technical mentoring, and cross-team collaboration with a diverse, co-located engineering team, while also visualizing customer issues as drivers for internal change.
 



 Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model 
Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.
